workflow: vLLM v0.1.0 CPU/GPU KV offload and token-block lifecycle
decision: retain conditional KV restore workflow; no ordinary failure or new IOMMU capability accepted

platform.main: Genesys2/CVA6 + four iDMA + RISC-V IOMMU + Linux

demand.branch: Selected scheduler preempts multiple RUNNING sequences and invokes SWAP; single sequence defaults to recomputation.
demand.purpose: Preserve all live unique KV of preempted group; restore before downstream layer overwrite/use.

variables.N: unique source slots in actual src_to_dst mapping

host_allocation.CPU: per-layer K and V torch.empty(size=(num_cpu_blocks,*shape), pin_memory=True)
host_allocation.pool_lifetime: CacheEngine holds backing pools; block free returns slot metadata without per-slot tensor teardown
host_allocation.actual_pin_and_IOMMU_map_timing: driver/runtime not inspected in this source limit

lifecycle.free: refcount decrement, append to free_blocks only when zero
lifecycle.COW: new GPU pool slot + existing GPU copy kernel before overwrite
lifecycle.swap_in: allocate GPU slots, deduplicate CPU slots, metadata free CPU slots, payload copied CPU->GPU
lifecycle.swap_out: allocate CPU slots, deduplicate GPU slots, metadata free GPU slots, payload copied GPU->CPU
lifecycle.native_layer_use_barrier: cache stream records each layer event; attention waits after optional prompt attention but before KV overwrite/decode read
lifecycle.original_no_input_path: worker queues waits on cache events and returns empty output; do not claim this return is CPU-wide synchronization

readiness_and_control.stable_pool_allocation_map_prepare: eligible earlier with full memory/startup/map cost
readiness_and_control.exact_src_to_dst: available at scheduler output before current Worker copy issue; based on current slot/refcount state
readiness_and_control.source_preissue_control_site: between scheduler output delivery and cache backend cudaMemcpyAsync issue
readiness_and_control.normal_decode_previous_output_sequencing: worker returns materialized sampling result -> scheduler update/stop/free -> next engine step

capacity.append_check_is_conservative: requires one free slot per running sequence, even when tail may have room
capacity.swap_in_check_is_conservative: unique restored slots + one reserved slot per swapped sequence + watermark

requesters.single_worker: one GPU; CUDA cache/compute streams are not separate DIDs
requesters.TP_each_worker: distinct head shard, common logical/physical block IDs in centralized manager
requesters.possible_FPGA_reinterpretation: two real iDMA/DID move same-direction distinct TP shards; requires explicit adapter, consumer, nonalias, capacity and hardware completion acceptance

baseline_requirements: single-sequence recomputation where native legal; full recompute costs
legal resident and partial-resident caches with all live/request completion budgets
admission/whole-group serial scheduling with user objective and both full completion costs
stable-pool allocation/pin/map prepare before payload readiness
legal 2MiB backing containing many independently managed logical slots, fallback/preparation costs included
contiguous two-ended run merge and ordinary scatter/batched copy with full staging/descriptor costs
all actual unique full-slot transfers and downstream uses; no partial-child success
real independent requesters; no CUDA-stream-to-DID substitution

separate_decisions.safety: Existing ordinary mechanisms already cover sourced use/reuse dependencies; no new IOMMU safety gap evidenced.
separate_decisions.demand: Finite real KV preservation/restore purpose exists conditionally; no finite instance proving unavoidable swap across strong baselines.
separate_decisions.implementable_action: Sourced current-copy preissue software control location exists; FPGA signal/adapter not accepted.
separate_decisions.novelty: GPU paging/refcount/COW/per-layer events cannot be claimed as new shared-IOMMU contribution because those exact actions are already present in fixed author source. No new translation action accepted.
separate_decisions.performance: No ordinary-method failure, measured residual PTW/HOL cost, or net gain evidenced.

redesign_premise.statement: If a finite real KV restore requires two distinct head-shard iDMA/DID transfers and live-capacity/use dependencies limit early payload preparation, and legal pool map prepare/2MiB/batching/residency still leave a measured translation-related wait, and pair mapping or layer-use metadata reaches an actionable site before current issue, evaluate dependency-informed current translation/issue control.
missing_part: physical shared IOMMU and independent DIDs on current adapter
specific ordinary failure and residual translation cost
new control information/action beyond ordinary prepare/control
complete resource/completion cost and measured net benefit
redesign_premise.positive_source_branch: Multi-sequence group selected for native SWAP, full unique KV retained and restored to per-layer use.
adjacent_counterexamples: all live KV fits legal residency
ordinary admission/serial groups completes the actual objective
huge-backed stable pools allow map prepare
ordinary copy/event order solves reuse with no residual translation wait
new signal arrives only after current copy completion

full_costs_unmeasured: extra staging or batched descriptor buffers
all groups downstream completion and drain
